Isak Scores Twice as Liverpool Earn First Win Under New Coach Iraola

Alexander Isak scored two goals in the opening nine minutes to secure Liverpool's 2-0 victory over Ipswich Town. This win marks the first for new manager Andoni Iraola and his team in the Premier League season. Bradley Barcola made his debut in the match. The coverage also mentions Cody Gakpo, who was reportedly close to leaving Liverpool but remained with the club.
